name: Essence Fastening Systems (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: Essence Fastening Systems (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of high-strength and high-precision fasteners and special-shaped parts for automobile systems in China. The company offers general-purpose high-strength bolts and nuts, precision machined products, connecting rods and high temperature resistant products, welding bolts and nuts, base products, adjustment, ball head screw, new energy vehicle fast swapping system, and plastic functional parts and fasteners.
